# token-lean-document-reading

Reads PDFs, email files (.eml and .msg), Word documents, zip archives, large text files and scanned images accurately at the lowest token cost, by inventorying first and then reading only the pages, headers, parts or line ranges that answer the question. Use when asked to read, search, summarise or extract facts from a PDF, a mail export, a .docx, a zip or a scan, or when a document is too large to open whole. Do NOT use for converting Markdown to a PDF (use markdown-to-pdf), or for producing a PDF that will be served or filed (use pdf-of-record).

- **Entry point:** [SKILL.md](SKILL.md)
- **Version:** 1.0.0
- **Licence:** Apache-2.0, see [LICENSE](LICENSE)

## Install

Copy this directory into either skills location, then start a new session:

```bash
cp -r token-lean-document-reading ~/.claude/skills/       # personal, all projects
cp -r token-lean-document-reading .claude/skills/         # this project only
```

For Claude Desktop, zip the directory and upload it under
Settings, Capabilities, Skills. Released builds attach a ready-made zip.

## Bundled files

Loaded on demand, not up front. SKILL.md routes to them.

- `references/mail-office-and-archives.md`
- `references/pdf-and-scans.md`
- `scripts/read_document.py`
- `scripts/test_read_document.py`
